bug fixes: Require both node and pod metrics for storage readiness. (@slashpai, PR #1818)
security updates: Bump Go version to v1.26.4, addressing CVE-2025-47907 and CVE-2025-47906. (@dependabot, @RainbowMango, @dgrisonnet, @yangjunmyfm192085, PR #1681, #1738, #1758, #1784, #1803, #1830)

bug fixes: Conditionally render `insecureSkipTLSVerify` field in APIService template to prevent GitOps sync drift when value is `false`. ([#1727](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/pull/1727)) _@pawl_
Do not render annotations as null in APIService template to prevent permanent OutOfSync in ArgoCD. ([#1752](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/pull/1752)) _@Serializator_
Fixed a bug causing kubectl get PodMetrics/NodeMetrics to fail
Handle Kernel bug leading to incorrect CPU usage data (@sleepyzhang)
Fix deadline exceeded errors caused by failure during metric parsing (https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/issues/983, @yangjunmyfm192085)
Restore support for klog specific flags removed by mistake in v0.6.0 (@yangjunmyfm192085)

breaking changes: Metrics Server now requires access to `nodes/metrics` RBAC resource instead of `nodes/stats`. No changes needed if you use official manifests, however please update RBAC resources if you just use Metrics Server image with custom manifests.
bug fixes: wait to be able to compute the resource usage of all the containers of a pod before exposing its PodMetrics(@yangjunmyfm192085)
Don‘t use Kubelet start time for metrics-server (@yangjunmyfm192085)
Fix reporting inconsistent number of nodes, caused by using invalid Kubelet node start time metric (@yangjunmyfm192085, https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/issues/803)
Fix reporting partial container metrics for pod (@yangjunmyfm192085, https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/pull/807)
Prevent reporting negative CPU value caused by unreliable cAdvisor timestamp (@sanwishe)
Skip metric points incorrectly reported as 0 by cAdvisor (@serathius)
